tasks.title: Plan 1 — Environment and Data Acquisition
acceptance_criteria: Colab T4 GPU environment set up; transformers, datasets, torchaudio, tensorboard, ctranslate2, streamlit installed (reuse NSTT-Lite/requirements.txt, already pinned to known-good versions from the original NSTT project)

OpenSLR SLR54 corpus available (reuse original NSTT Colab/Drive download rather than re-downloading ~8GB from scratch, if that Drive copy is accessible; otherwise re-run src/slr54.py download functions, which already skip existing files)
File counts verified against SLR54 documentation (157,905 utterances expected per utt_spk_text.tsv)
Screenshots captured: Colab runtime type (GPU), library versions, dataset download completing
tasks.progress: Local .venv created (Python 3.13); requirements.txt installed with ctranslate2 relaxed to >=4.6 locally only (4.5.0 pin has no py3.13 wheel — requirements.txt itself left untouched as the Colab-verified pin). All imports smoke-tested OK (transformers 4.49.0, datasets 3.2.0, torch 2.13.0, ctranslate2 4.8.1, sklearn 1.6.1). No CUDA locally (Apple MPS) — actual fine-tuning still targets Colab T4 per roadmap. Corpus found at data/openslr54_ne/ (user-supplied, not via src/slr54.py download): utt_spk_text.tsv has 157,905 rows (matches SLR54 docs exactly); audio present for 6,542/157,905 utterances across 12 of 16 subdirs (01/03/07/08/0d empty) — confirmed intentional partial sample by user, sufficient for Plan 2's 10-20hr subset target. Removed stray empty data/raw/slr54/ dir (leftover from before real corpus location was found). Screenshots N/A (local run, not Colab).

tasks.title: Plan 2 — Preprocessing and Dataset Split
acceptance_criteria: Audio resampled to 16kHz mono; invalid/corrupt clips dropped (reuse src/preprocessing.py duration/format filtering)
Nepali transcripts NFC-normalized, punctuation/casing cleaned
Speaker gender labels extracted or derived from SLR54 metadata for every utterance in the working subset (NEW — not in original NSTT pipeline)

Speaker-disjoint 10-20 hour subset built (smaller than original NSTT's full ~165hr corpus) and split 80/10/10 train/val/test with zero speaker overlap confirmed (reuse src/splits.py speaker_disjoint_split + count_speaker_overlap)
Finalized, versioned manifest (CSV/JSON) mapping audio → transcript → speaker → gender → split
tasks.progress: Corpus grown to 55,980 files (96 subdirs) via additional SLR54 shard downloads. gender field added to MANIFEST_FIELDS; populated via an F0-pitch acoustic heuristic (librosa pyin, 165Hz threshold) since SLR54 ships NO gender metadata at all (verified against openslr.org/54 listing) — this is a pseudo-label, not ground truth, documented everywhere it appears. Real manifests regenerated: 15,459 utterances / 146 speakers / 15.03hrs, speaker-disjoint 80/10/10, 0 speaker overlap confirmed via count_speaker_overlap(). Done directly by Claude rather than via the Cursor handoff cycle (interactive session, not a batch implementation task).

tasks.title: Plan 3 — Baseline Evaluation (Zero-Shot)
acceptance_criteria: Pretrained Whisper-Small run zero-shot (no fine-tuning) on the Nepali test set; WER/CER computed and logged
Trivial gender-classification baseline built (majority-class or simple acoustic-feature classifier) for comparison
Every run screenshotted with visible device info
tasks.progress: Zero-shot whisper-small on 150 real test utterances: WER=221.76%, CER=147.39% (reports/wer_cer_results.md). Majority-class gender baseline (predict F0-pseudo-label majority for every utterance): 75.16% (reports/baseline_gender.json). No screenshots -- ran locally (CPU/MPS), not Colab; device info logged in text instead. Done directly by Claude.

tasks.title: Plan 4 — ASR Fine-Tuning Setup
acceptance_criteria: Seq2SeqTrainer script written: AdamW, FP16, batch size 2, gradient accumulation 4, max 5 epochs, early stopping (patience 2 on validation WER) — reuse/extend src/training.py from original NSTT where applicable
TensorBoard logging and checkpoint saving to Drive wired up (NEW vs. original NSTT, which didn't use TensorBoard)
Short smoke-test run (a few dozen steps) confirms the loop works end-to-end without crashing
tasks.progress: src/training.py extended with max_train/max_eval slicing (needed so eval doesn't run generation over the full val set every eval_steps -- a real bottleneck hit during the smoke test). Smoke test (6 steps, 32 train/8 eval rows) ran end-to-end without crashing; models/smoke_test/checkpoint-6 exists. TensorBoard confirmed actually logging (not just configured) -- verified train/loss scalars readable via EventAccumulator, steps 1-6, values 1.70->0.83. This satisfied the loop-correctness bar; T-005 covers the REAL full-scale run, which still needs to happen on Colab T4 (300 local CPU/MPS steps in T-005's current progress were a proof-of-loop run, not the intended budget).

tasks.title: Plan 5 — ASR Fine-Tuning Execution (full-scale, Colab T4)
acceptance_criteria: Run notebooks/plan4_colab.ipynb Steps 0-1 (or scripts/run_colab_training.py directly) on an actual Colab T4 GPU runtime -- NOT local CPU/MPS. Confirm torch.cuda.is_available() prints True before training starts.

Full fine-tuning run to early-stopping criterion (patience 2 on val WER) or the 5-epoch/2000-step ceiling, whichever comes first -- this uses the real full train/val splits (max_train=None, max_eval=None), not the 300-step/reduced-eval local run already in models/finetuned

TensorBoard curves (train/loss, eval/wer) screenshotted showing a real multi-step curve, plus a screenshot of the GPU runtime type and library versions (Colab: Runtime -> Change runtime type -> T4 GPU, then the printed torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) output)
Best checkpoint saved to models/finetuned_full/, selected by validation WER (load_best_model_at_end=True, metric_for_best_model='wer')
Report the final global_step reached (needed by T-005b's matched-step ablation) and eval_wer/eval_loss at that step
tasks.human_prerequisite: This is the main GPU wall-clock step (multi-hour). Requires an actual Colab T4 GPU session -- cannot run on local CPU/MPS and cannot be executed by Claude directly (no GPU access from this environment). Buffer extra time; resumable checkpointing via trainer.train(resume_from_checkpoint=...) is required if the Colab session disconnects mid-run.

tasks.title: Plan 6 — Speaker Gender Classification (Second Task)
acceptance_criteria: Fixed-length embeddings extracted from the fine-tuned Whisper encoder (mean-pooled hidden states) per utterance
Lightweight classifier head (logistic regression or small MLP, scikit-learn) trained on these embeddings to predict speaker gender
Evaluated with accuracy, precision/recall, F1, and a confusion matrix; compared against the Plan 3 trivial baseline

tasks.title: Plan 7 — Evaluation and Error Analysis
acceptance_criteria: Final WER/CER (baseline vs fine-tuned) computed for ASR; final classification metrics for gender prediction
ASR errors categorized: substitutions, insertions, deletions, phonetic confusion, OOV words, code-switching, pronunciation variation, with example tables (reuse/extend src/error_analysis.py)
Classification errors analyzed: which speakers/genders/utterance types get misclassified and why
Written interpretation tying results back to the research question

tasks.title: Plan 8 — Optimization and Deployment
acceptance_criteria: Fine-tuned Whisper model converted to CTranslate2 format
Inference latency benchmarked via Faster-Whisper (CPU and GPU if available)
Streamlit app built/extended: audio upload, transcription, gender prediction, WER/CER summary, inference time display (extend original NSTT dashboard rather than rebuilding from scratch)
Screenshots of the running app performing both tasks on sample inputs

tasks.title: Plan 9 — Evidence and Appendix Assembly
acceptance_criteria: Every screenshot (environment, each experiment, TensorBoard, Streamlit app) collected and organized, each showing device/software
Complete code (preprocessing, training, evaluation, classification, conversion, Streamlit) assembled into appendix-ready format, external-source code clearly marked
Cross-checked against the brief: no external links anywhere except the dataset link; the 1-page proposal reproduced exactly in the appendix

tasks.title: Plan 10 — Report Writing and Final Submission
acceptance_criteria: Report written in order: title, introduction, background/related work, problem/method, experimental section, discussion, conclusion, references, appendices
All prior findings compressed into the strict 4500-word limit; full technical detail lives in the appendix
Exact 1-page proposal inserted into the appendix, verbatim
Proofread for language standards; citations correct; figure/table captions credit any non-original material
Exported to required file format/naming (NAME_studentID), submitted via Campus 4.0
tasks.human_prerequisite: Writing itself is a human task, not a Cursor implementation task — Duo's role here is compiling/organizing inputs, not drafting the report prose.
